query: I’m evaluating a 73‑year‑old woman with multi‑trauma. For female inpatients 68–78 with multi‑trauma, report first‑24h medication complexity quartiles, average complexity percentile, LOS and mortality for those with serotonergic interaction risk versus other multi‑trauma patients, and LOS/mortality for top quartile.
final_sql: SELECT mp.subject_id AS male_patient_id, fp.subject_id AS female_patient_id, mcq.medication_count, fcq.medication_count, mcp.avg_percentile_rank, fcp.avg_percentile_rank, mlom.length_of_stay, flom.length_of_stay, mlomtq.subject_id AS male_patient_id_top_quartile, flomtq.subject_id AS female_patient_id_top_quartile FROM male_complexity_quartiles mcq JOIN female_complexity_quartiles fcq ON mcq.subject_id = fcq.subject_id JOIN male_complexity_avg_percentile mcp ON mcq.subject_id = mcp.subject_id JOIN female_complexity_avg_percentile fcp ON fcq.subject_id = fcp.subject_id JOIN male_los_mortality mlom ON mlom.subject_id = mcq.subject_id JOIN female_los_mortality flom ON flom.subject_id = fcq.subject_id JOIN male_los_mortality_top_quartile mlomtq ON mlomtq.subject_id = mcq.subject_id JOIN female_los_mortality_top_quartile flomtq ON flomtq.subject_id = fcq.subject_id JOIN patients p ON p.subject_id = mcq.subject_id JOIN admissions a ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE a.admission_type_id IN (SELECT admission_type_id FROM admissions WHERE name = 'Multi-trauma') ORDER BY mcq.medication_count NULLS LAST;
